title: Magical Sempai
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An unmotivated first-year boy is recruited as assistant by Sempai, the last member of the school Magic Club, who is a skilled stage magician alone but botches every trick from stage fright when anyone watches. Short gag chapters follow her failed tricks, which often end in revealing or suggestive mishaps, with a growing club of oddball members.
life_message: Mostly played for laughs: friendship forms around a shared, clumsy hobby.

Anime adaptation; cosplay costumes as gags.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Senpai-kohai labels used, but Assistant is often more competent.

folkways.japan: Senpai-kohai club structure and club-member minimums are standard Japanese school-club conventions.

delivery.evidence: Gag manga of short chapters; summaries show no stated message.
delivery.note: A gag comedy with little message beyond friendship around a hobby.

winners_losers: No ideological winners; Sempai's clumsy persistence is the comic center and the club grows around her.
